process.mask_layer_polarity: filled mask polygon = opening/removal of green soldermask

coordinate_policy: 37mm exterior-view SVG x right/y down; no horizontal mirror on either face
native_polygon_winding: outer clockwise, each inner hole counterclockwise in native mil x/y

trace.thin_tip_policy: Original sharp animal tips retained; local tips may be below 0.15 mm. CAM review required.

source_metadata.mask_openings: none; this front cover has no physical apertures

source_metadata.source_stroke_policy: Existing white source edges/border retained with minimum 0.22 mm stroke
source_metadata.star_marker_policy: Visible 0.22 mm white rings around original physical hole centers; no change to hole centers or diameters
source_metadata.text_policy: Same text and baselines; original fine serif outlines replaced by DejaVu Sans Bold 1.7 mm native fill outlines

limitations: Animal sharp tips can be locally narrower than 0.15mm; verify CAM without automatic wholesale art distortion.
Green and white previews are source-backed design simulations; not photographs or fabrication approval.
Mask and silk are newly generated ordinary PCB artwork; original copper, electrical and physical aperture geometry are unchanged.
